newsitem.title: USA: Brightpoint unit president gives up post.
newsitem.headline: Brightpoint unit president gives up post.

text.p: Brightpoint Inc said Friday Vice Chairman Robert Picow will relinquish his title as president of Brightpoint North America but remain vice chairman of the parent company.

A Brightpoint spokeswoman said Picow made the decision himself in order to devote more time to strategic and business planning. As vice chairman, he "will be available to consult with the company," Brightpoint said in a statement.

Picow's duties as president of the North American operation will be divided among Brightpoint's top executives, including Chairman and Chief Executive Robert Laikin, President Mark Howell and Chief Financial Officer Phillip Bounsall.
